meal.title: Build a Student class
meal.objective: Combine a class, constructor, attributes, and a method to model a student

voice.script: What if you could turn a real student into a tiny program? How do we model a student with name and grades? A class is like a school blueprint, and each student we create is an object. Here’s the Student class definition. Python lets us group related data and behavior inside a class. First we write the class name. Inside we define an __init__ method that receives a name and stores it on the instance as an attribute. Then we add a method called average_marks that receives a list of grades, computes their average, and prints a message. Finally we create a Student object named Alice and ask it to calculate the average of three marks. Running the program prints the average of the grades. A class bundles data and behavior for many objects. Now try creating another class called Account with a balance attribute.
